* Same specs: over-ear, ANC + transparency, up to 40 hours with ANC on, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, headphones + carry case + USB-C cable + 3.5mm cable

**Brackmoor Sound - /b**
* $129.00

* In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days
* 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method
